title: LS:MP resource manifest
description: manifest.json of an LS:MP resource. The resource's name is its folder name. https://lsmp.gg/resources/api#resource-layout

paths.description: A path or pattern relative to the resource folder, with /, or a list of them. * matches within one folder, ** at any depth, ? one character.

names.description: A resource name, or a list of them.

title.description: Display name (admin panel, marketplace). Never an identity.

version.description: Display only. Marketplace versions are managed by lsmp.gg.

shared_scripts.description: Scripts run on both sides, before the side-specific ones (.lua or .js).

server_scripts.description: Scripts run on the server (.lua, .js, .mjs, .cjs). Never sent to players.

client_scripts.description: Scripts run in each player's game (.lua or .js), in this order.

files.description: Extra files sent to players, not run: data read with lsmp.readResourceFile.

webui.description: Folders served to the resource's pages at rsc://<name>/ (the built output, e.g. "web" or "ui/dist").

dependencies.description: Resources that must be started first, on both sides.

server_dependencies.description: Resources that must be started first, on the server only.

client_dependencies.description: Resources that must be started first, in the player's game only.

data_files.description: Game data files mounted in the player's game with the resource.

oneOf.description: A file whose type is known from its name: vehicles.meta, handling.meta, carcols.meta, carvariations.meta, vehiclelayouts.meta, weapons.meta, peds.meta, water.xml, dlctext.meta...

path.description: The file, relative to the resource.

type.description: The game's data file type (VEHICLE_METADATA_FILE, CARCOLS_FILE...). Deduced from the name when absent.

set.description: A stream set: the file is mounted and unmounted with it.

language.description: For a .gxt2 text file: the game language it is for (american, french...).

stream_sets.description: Parts of stream/ that scripts load and unload in game (lsmp.resources.loadStreamSet).

name.description: Not a manifest key: the identity is the folder name. Use title for a display name.

enabled.description: Not a manifest key: use "enabled" in the server's resources.json.

scripts.description: List scripts in client_scripts, server_scripts or shared_scripts.

webui_domain.description: Use webui: pages are always served at rsc://<resource name>/.
